scheme_name: UP Startup Policy & One District One Product (ODOP)
overview: The UP Startup Policy & One District One Product (ODOP) is a state-level initiative by the Government of Uttar Pradesh aimed at fostering entrepreneurship, promoting local products, and building a robust startup ecosystem across all districts of the state. It integrates financial support, incubation, market access, and skill development to empower startups and artisans, particularly those engaged in ODOP-identified products. The policy emphasizes inclusive growth by targeting women, SC/ST, and rural entrepreneurs, and aligns with central government schemes like Startup India and Stand-Up India.
objectives: Promote entrepreneurship and innovation across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh
Strengthen the One District One Product (ODOP) initiative by linking it with startup support
Provide financial assistance, incubation, and mentorship to early-stage startups
Enhance market access and branding for ODOP products through e-commerce and exhibitions
Support skill development and training for entrepreneurs and artisans
Encourage women, SC/ST, and rural entrepreneurs to participate in the startup ecosystem
Facilitate convergence with central government schemes like Startup India, Stand-Up India, and PMFME
Create employment opportunities and boost local economic development
eligibility: Eligible beneficiaries include startups registered in Uttar Pradesh, MSMEs, artisans, self-help groups, and individuals engaged in ODOP-identified products. Preference is given to women, SC/ST, and rural entrepreneurs. Startups must be recognized by DPIIT or registered under the UP Startup Policy. Entities must have a viable business plan related to ODOP products or services and comply with state government guidelines.
benefits: Benefits include financial grants up to INR 10 lakhs for product development, marketing, and certification; interest-free loans; seed funding; incubation support at state-approved incubators; mentorship from industry experts; assistance in patent filing and IPR; participation in national and international trade fairs; e-commerce platform integration; branding and packaging support; and access to raw material banks and common facility centers.
financial_support: Financial support includes grants of up to INR 10 lakhs per entity for product development, certification, and market promotion; interest-free loans up to INR 25 lakhs for working capital and machinery; seed funding of up to INR 5 lakhs for idea validation; and reimbursement of up to 50% of costs for ISO, FSSAI, or other certifications. Funds are disbursed through the Uttar Pradesh Trade Promotion Authority (UPTPA) or designated nodal agencies after project appraisal.
application_process: 1. Visit the official UP Startup Policy portal at startup.up.gov.in. 2. Register as a beneficiary by filling the online application form. 3. Submit details of the business idea, ODOP product linkage, and required documents. 4. Await preliminary screening by the district-level committee. 5. Present the business plan before the state-level evaluation committee. 6. Receive approval and sanction letter. 7. Submit utilization reports and claim disbursement of funds as per milestones.
required_documents: PAN card of the entity or applicant
Proof of linkage to ODOP product (if applicable)
Gender certificate (for women applicants, if seeking special benefits)
Quotations for machinery or equipment (if seeking loan for capital expenditure)
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds.
implementing_agency: Uttar Pradesh Trade Promotion Authority (UPTPA), under the Department of Infrastructure and Industrial Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
caveats: Financial assistance is subject to availability of funds and budget allocation
Beneficiaries must utilize funds only for the approved purpose and submit utilization certificates
Failure to comply with project timelines may lead to cancellation of sanction
Double benefits from other central or state schemes for the same activity are not permitted
The policy is subject to revision or withdrawal by the state government
